mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS call_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mc.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mc.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failure_count, COALESCE(SUM(mc.input_token_count), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(mc.output_token_count), 0) AS output_tokens, CAST(COALESCE(ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN mc.started_at IS NOT NULL AND mc.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND mc.finished_at >= mc.started_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, mc.started_at, mc.finished_at) / 1000.0 ELSE NULL END )), 0) AS SIGNED) AS average_latency_ms
mapper.select:
SELECT mc.connection_id, COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(mc.connection_name_snapshot, '')), CONCAT('Connection #', mc.connection_id)) AS connection_name,
GROUP BY mc.connection_id ORDER BY call_count DESC, connection_name ASC, mc.connection_id ASC

SELECT mc.model_profile_id, COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(mc.model_name_snapshot, '')), 'Unknown model') AS model_name,
GROUP BY mc.model_profile_id, CASE WHEN mc.model_profile_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(mc.model_name_snapshot, ''), 'Unknown model') ELSE NULL END ORDER BY call_count DESC, model_name ASC, COALESCE(mc.model_profile_id, 0) ASC

SELECT DATE(mc.created_at) AS usage_date,
GROUP BY DATE(mc.created_at) ORDER BY usage_date ASC
